units.title: ps2
examples: falling-head permeameter: derive head against time from Darcy's law and mass balance
layered aquifer: equivalent horizontal and vertical K, transmissivity and flow per unit width

units.title: ps5
examples: estimate K from heads in a line of wells and a plume's travel; time for a solute to reach a well (advection, sorption retardation)
steady pumping well at the centre of a circular island in a lake: head and drawdown with radius (Thiem with a constant-head boundary)

units.title: final_20041
examples: explain the difference between paired terms (dispersivity and dispersion coefficient, effective and total stress, isotherms)
injection well near a no-flow boundary and a constant-head lake: place image wells; is the head change larger or smaller
label a subsurface cross-section: water table, vadose and phreatic zones, capillary fringe, confined and unconfined aquifers, potentiometric surface, perched water, artesian well
pumped confined aquifer: why flow toward the well computed from nearby heads grows with time (transient storage)
two mechanisms of overland flow (infiltration excess and saturation excess) and when each occurs
